Messages.Author: Hamdamcwa
Messages.Body:
>Hi. A while ago i tried to star a discussion on the FInal Nights expansion,
>mainly what people expect from it and such, but I has not been replied to
>once

I think you just came in a bit late. The whole "what do you think is going to
be in it" had been done to death months ago. In general terms, I think the
concesus is the following:

1) A "Path of Paradox" or similar for the Ravnos since all the good Chimestry
cards cost (usually a couple of blood too!).

2) Something to hose S:CE for the Assamites.

3) Something useful and FAST for serpentis, since nearly all Serpentis actions
take too much time to get going.

4) Some decent Giovanni vampires, since few have more than one of their clan
disiplines at superior.

I think current speculation states that the Precons will be looked at with
great interest, since there will probably be an Ancient Hearts rare in each,
and the feeling is that Dreams of the Sphinx will be in one of them. Since it
is a mega rare card, expect the lucky clan to sell like hot cakes!

It has also been intimated that the edge will be more integral to the game as a
result of this expansion (or was it the next one? I can't remember!) with there
being more cards that you can only use if you have the edge.

Personally, since Final Nights is based on the current clan novel series, I
would like to see a few flavoured cards - e.g

Eye of Hazimel: Unique Weapon, cost 2 pool.
Does 2R agg as a strike, with an optional press. Bearer can enter combat with
any minion as a D action. The bearer cannot do any actions except attack (or
hunt if on 0 blood) whilst he has the eye. Any vampire can steal the eye as a D
action, Setites get +1 Stealth on this action.

Gangrel Exodus
Vote, called at +1 Stealth.
If this vote is successful, all Gangrel are now considered independant for the
rest of the game. Each Gangrel gets an addtional vote in this action.

Etchings of Anatole, Prophet of Gehenna
Master
Burn any Malkavian with a capacity less than 6. Only one Etchings of Anatole,
Prophet of Gehenna can be played in a game.

And of course, the themed vampires! Romana would be great, Leopold and Nickoli
interesting, and Calebos niiiice.

Just do a search on the term Final Nights on the Google Newsgroups interface
under rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad. You should find it all there.

DH

It has been somewhat quiet around here lately...

We had a marked drop of traffic when Deja stopped doing news but I can't
account for the recent disappearances. The Yahoo Group has grown
considerably in the past few months so I don't think this is due to a lack
of interest in the game itself. I've even posted instructions there on how
to set up Usenet in Outlook Express in the hopes of drawing some of them
here. A few showed up but not many.

It seems that a lot of ISPs are not providing access to Usenet right now for
some reason. As someone who works at an ISP, I find this rather strange.
Granted, it's not a function that many internet users gravitate to but
still...

Another possibility is simply a lack of controversy. Many of the cards from
Sabbat War have been deconstructed and analyzed to death. We're all waiting
patiently for Final Nights to come out so we can discuss new cards. There's
only so much one can say about Waste Management Operation after all.

Also, controversial/annoying posters seem to have been scared away, more's
the better so there's less reason to post flames hehe. Maybe I'll end this
post by saying something controversial... hmm... no, can't think of
anything.

Cheers,
WES
